verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a public REST API for running tasks and agents. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec is served at api.skyvern.com, backed by per-endpoint reference pages with a live Try-it playground, API-key authentication docs, a formal deprecation and sunset policy, and Python/TypeScript SDKs. The probe's 404s on skyvern.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is hosted on the api subdomain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving the product via the API.
